content:
maya: Quick sync — prototype for a 'Fallback scenario walkthrough' landing panel. Wanted feedback on how we expose degrade modes, trigger thresholds, and audit sampling. Link: https://figma.mock/redwood/fallback-walkthrough :link:
kevin: Nice start. Can we show the active trigger reason inline (e.g. '500 spike', 'model-oom') so engineers don't have to open another view? :thinking:
sam: Agree. Also need a clear CTA to 'Inspect playback' for audited requests so SREs can replay the exact inputs.
ania: Question: how do we represent sampled audit vs full logging? We shouldn't make full payload retention the default (privacy/regulatory).
maya: Proposed: two controls — 'Audit sampling %' and 'Store full payloads' (off by default). Tooltip explains costs and privacy tradeoffs.
kevin: UI nit: place the degrade-mode selector near routing priority. People usually tune them together. Suggest radios: 
  - soft degrade (latency-first)
  - hard degrade (cost-first)
  - fallback-only (route to cheaper model)
  - bypass (no degrade)
sam: +1. Also autoswitch TTL defaults matter — 5m is safe but ops may want 30s for short canaries. Expose a recommended preset and an advanced number field.
ania: For error triggers, support boolean chain conditions. Example: 
  "error_rate > 5% for 1m AND p50_latency > 1s" — expressive but still understandable.
maya: Mock grammar example for the trigger editor: 
```
trigger:
  - name: high_error_and_latency
    when: "error_rate > 0.05 && p50_latency > 1000"
    window: 60s
    action: fallback_to:model-small
```
kevin: Love the concise DSL. UI should validate and show a quick preview of matched traffic (simulate against last hour). :chart_with_upwards_trend:
sam: Telemetry: emit a decision_event that records { trigger_id, eval_window, sample_id, routed_model, fallback_reason }. The sampling decision should be server-side and deterministic for traceability.
deploy-bot: rollout-ui-proto -> canary (10%) deployed :white_check_mark: 
ania: Audit/legal note — store only references or hashed payloads by default. If customer opts into full payload retention, surface required approvals and retention duration (default 30d).
maya: Next steps: I'll update the prototype with: 1) degrade-mode radios next to routing priority, 2) trigger grammar + simulator, 3) sampling toggle + retention UI + ken/ops tooltips. Will ping for final review.
kevin: Assign to maya and tag me when ready for UI polish.
sam: Ops — can you provide a small replay query for the simulator? I'll wire it to run on a 1h window so the preview is meaningful.
maya: Thanks — adding a short checklist to the PR: simulator hookup, server-side sampling impl, audit retention banner. Draft doc at internal.redwood/fallback-playbook (WIP). :memo:
